title: The World Builder's square panel: pick, template, picture waiting, keep, redo
oneLine: Which square is open, its template, the picture waiting to be kept, painted or redoing (dormant loop).
topConcern: async select() never re-checks the selected square: a slow earlier select paints its template and prompt under a later square's title.

title: The World Builder's stored work across four stores: keep, redo, re-fuse, restore, backup
oneLine: The project record, raw pictures, fused chunks and thumbnail in IndexedDB, written by keep, redo, rebuild, restore.
topConcern: Keep flushes fused chunks before saving the record, uncaught: a refused put or reload leaves orphan pixels the next fuse treats as finished.

title: The busy overlay and the page's one toast
oneLine: S.busy and the full-screen overlay around every long job; the toast's hide timer.
topConcern: redo, backup, restore, rebuild and style key rely on the overlay, not S.busy; a keyboard press gets past it.

title: The fused world's chunk cache: loaded, written (dirty), flushed
oneLine: LRU of 512 px fused tiles with a dirty set, flushed to IndexedDB one put each.
topConcern: no in-flight de-dupe: two loads of one tile can drop a write; unreachable while keep runs under the overlay.

title: The style key: none, saved, replaced (and read by the two other studios)
oneLine: The map's style key picture kept in the World Builder's misc store, read by Ground and Object Studios.
topConcern: set in memory before its put: a refused put shows Saved until reload; open studio tabs keep the old key.

title: Has the plan moved under a painted square? and the backup nag
oneLine: Per-square planKey against today's plan, whole-plan hash for old records, squares kept since last backup.
topConcern: a cancelled backup download still silences the nag.

title: The studios' IndexedDB store: opened at version 1 for ever, one transaction per call
oneLine: Each studio database's creation, its stores, open and close; one transaction per get/put.
topConcern: version fixed at 1: a store added to any studio's list never appears in an existing database (NotFoundError, no upgrade path).

title: The ground worker's life and its one message line
oneLine: Worker loaded, initialising, ready; requests in order on one promise chain; idle block building when empty.
topConcern: throws off the line (whereIs, idleBlock) reach the game's onerror, which rejects every piece in flight as if the worker died.

title: A ground picture's download: queued, downloading, here, backing off, chased
oneLine: Per swatch file: quiet or urgent in the line, four downloads, 15 s limit, backoff, LRU of files.
topConcern: a queued prefetch promoted to urgent never calls pump(): it waits behind three prefetches with the reserved line idle, and its piece goes partial.

title: A piece laid short, and laid again when its picture comes (partial, lacking, owed, got, relay)
oneLine: Worker marks a piece partial with lacking pictures, says got when one arrives; renderer relays it.
topConcern: got means the file came, not that it will unpack or stay: lean eviction makes a refetch loop; unreadable counts as mended.

title: A ground picture in the worker: unpacked, let go, squeezed cold, thawed, calmed, or unreadable for good
oneLine: Decoded LRU, lean squeeze to cold and thaw, calmed water, and the terminal unreadable set.
topConcern: any unpack exception, including a canvas or bitmap refused at the memory ceiling, marks the swatch unreadable for the whole visit.

title: What the worker learns once, at its start: ground manifest, objects manifest, baked objects, studio tiles
oneLine: Swatch sources, footstep choices, objects with manifest, bake and doors, fixed for the visit at ready.
topConcern: init fetches have no timeout or retry: one failed manifest means plan-colour ground or no buildings and doors all visit; a hang stalls ready.

title: The blocks the worker keeps, and the game's copy of their walls
oneLine: Worker's built blocks (16/48 nearest the last where) and the game's 96 by arrival; missing reads open.
topConcern: walls stay right only while the game's 96 outlast the worker's kept blocks; untested invariant, near() fed only by where.
